_about: Frank's emotions and face expressions (README 4.14, Step 9B), read by UMRLabBehaviorComponent at BeginPlay. Recipes: MetaHuman face controls (CTRL_expressions_*) at full activation, seeded from Epic's facial poses (/MetaHumanCharacter/Optional/Animation/TemplateAnimations/Facial_Poses) and action units; strength scales all of them.

gates._about: impact is the Decisions score divided by 3 (flat 0, mild 0.33, clear 0.67, strong 1); below strong_impact a reaction needs the same answer on the next fragment within confirm_seconds.

speaking._about: While Frank speaks the layer keeps the upper face, gives the mouth corners 30 %, never the rest of the mouth (the lip sync owns it).

delivery._about: Frank's own delivery (agent-side Decisions): lip sync mood (Epic's EAudioDrivenAnimationMood index and intensity) set when his words are heard, an expression category, and a share of the slow mood. plain keeps the mood the voice gives.

interrupted._about: Interrupted (owner, D110, D112, D113): the visitor's clip-on microphone is above level (RMS) for min_speech s (dips shorter than quiet_gap s belong to it), starting while his voice is heard (or within a phrase pause of it): his voice stops at the end of the word being heard (also when he just started or is nearly done, D126); at least into s into his turn, a short surprise and the head tilting back by head_back_degrees (6 until 2026-11-18, owner: slightly less), then the then face after then_after s; the eyes stay on the visitor for look_seconds s; at most once in cooldown s. No surprise when he is nearly done (his newest words end his turn, turn_final and a sentence end, and are heard within finished_within s). Silent while the visitor speaks (owner, D126): a loud stretch that starts while he is silent holds back his voice that comes meanwhile, and after a stop the rest waits too, until the microphone has been below level for resume_after s; then it plays (silence in it dropped). level must sit above Frank's own voice in that microphone (set it in the lab).

notice._about: When the visitor speaks after a pause (or no conversation) while Frank looks around: a small brow raise as he looks back (owner, D107).

turns._about: Who speaks, for gaze and blinks (README 4.10). Frank's voice from the lip sync's mouth weight; the visitor from the loudness of the audio sent (microphone or test input), counted only after Frank has been silent echo_guard_seconds (no echo cancellation, Q24). Frank's turn ends after frank_end_quick of silence once the words Decisions marked turn_final were heard, else after frank_end_seconds: pauses inside his answers reach 1.7 s (replay, 2026-11-17). A conversation starts when the visitor speaks and ends when they stay silent disengage_seconds after his last words (owner, D124); waiting yield_max_seconds for his answer becomes a pause, which ends the conversation after conversation_seconds of silence.

gaze._about: Where Frank looks (README 4.10, D90, D104 to D107, D124). Only in a conversation the visitor started by speaking; on the visitor whenever they speak. Looking around (his eyes stay avoid_degrees from the visitor's face, the drift's goals twice that): his attention drifts on a smooth random path (wander_*: degrees from straight ahead, a new goal every wander_every s, wander_step from the last, eased over wander_seconds, never resting), the eyes jump around it (eye_hop_every, hop_spread, a little ahead), the head follows wander_head_yaw_share of it sideways; the head takes head_down_share of any look down and head_up_share of a look up, the eyes the rest; eye movements take eye_shift_base + eye_shift_per_degree seconds, eased in and out; the head starts head_delay s after the eyes and is 95 % there after head_seconds. eye_degrees: measured eye rotation per eye look curve at 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0 (+ right / up), and each eye's rest direction, in the head bone's frame.

eye_degrees._about: Measured 2026-11-17 (Simulate, PreviewFaceControl, FACIAL_L_Eye / FACIAL_R_Eye local Z against the head bone): linear, each curve moves only its own eye; eyeParallelLookDirection changes nothing.

blinks._about: Frank's own blinks on top of the lip sync model's (README 4.10): per minute at rest and speaking, x (1 + arousal_gain x arousal); with gaze shifts above shift_degrees; a long blink as 'understood' after a visitor turn; no blink starts within min_gap seconds of the last one, own or the model's (a model blink that would is left out, D125).

posture._about: Frank's body in Play (README 4.15, Step 9D, D131): body_anim is put on the body when Play starts (outside Play he keeps the A-pose, D130). In a conversation (not outside, not in a pause) the chest turns chest_share of the visitor's direction, at most chest_max degrees; while the visitor speaks and while he thinks it leans listen_lean degrees forward; valence below the persona baseline lowers chest and head by lower_per_valence degrees per unit, at most lower_max. All on the spine (MRLab Life node), eased: 95 % after seconds.

nods._about: Small nods while Frank speaks (Step 9D, D131): his voice is read lead seconds ahead of what is heard; a loudness peak at least peak times its running mean (over about mean_seconds) and min_level (RMS), at least min_gap seconds after the last nod, starts a nod: down in down seconds, back in up seconds, base degrees just above the threshold up to top for a peak twice the threshold, towards emphasis_top on words Decisions gives strength 3 (2: half way), times up to 1 + arousal_gain when the slow mood is excited. Head target degrees (the head turns about 70 % of them).
